_about: GOVERNANCE MASTER mapping: how AKP facts / elements become Decision Graph Engine rulebook nodes. Reviewed by people; nothing here is guessed by a model.

spine._about: The spine is added to every rulebook first (the engine team's s.7 rulebook). MKPs whose citation_key starts with a 'covers' prefix are already in the spine and are not converted again.
spine._test_note: AKP test cases run on one-step test packs (governance_master_ss/build.py _test_pack): products from other steps become test inputs, so no spine facts are needed.

type_warnings.LIST: a LIST fact became TEXT: rules on it may need review
type_warnings.PERIOD: a PERIOD fact became AMOUNT: give it in days

_scope_note: Only 'transaction' needs no scope key in the transaction file; set use_entity_scopes=true once the transaction builder sends scope_keys.

fact_aliases._about: AKP fact id -> spine fact id, only where the meaning AND the options are the same.

product_aliases._about: AKP PD id -> product that produces it (spine or member), when AKP named it differently.

value_aliases._about: The spine asks 'is anything other than money given?' (F_NMC). Review these with a tax expert before trusting them.
